author.same_underlying_model_risk: Separate actual agent executions may share model errors; design authorship must be disclosed in later adjudication.

problem.gap: The added development event at19 was not queried before supersession. Longer history alone did not add a decisive answer dependency. Existing ID/position rotations do not certify semantic/key-role coverage in a new batch.
problem.requested_change: Add exact before/at status-or-typed-value changes, active version/time/index conflicts, null lifecycle and measured relevance/name/position controls under unchanged episodic semantics.

planned_counts.key_role_schedule: Exact measured within-family crossing may reuse the eight query-rotation variants; it adds no multiplier or independent source family.
planned_counts.base_signature_counting: Decode consistent key-role renames before counting eight base query signatures per controlled history.

required_in_row_witnesses: For a decisive delayed boundary, same-key queries at T-1 and T, T>=1; winner at T has at=T and changes status or typed value.
A later eligible lower-version competitor disagrees with the older higher-version winner; latest-time-only retrieval produces a different semantic answer.
Same-version time and same-version/time input-order conflicts must occur at the active eligible maximum and have differing semantic answers.
A winning tombstone has an eligible lower-version put competitor; present-null contrasts with an actual absent/deleted-null query.
Future and cross-key filtering tags require contenders whose selection by the stated incorrect filter omission would change semantic answer.
Absence requires zero eligible exact-key events and separately records missing-key or future-only subtype.
required_family_audits: Declare eight semantic role signatures and exact rotation schedule; after decoding consistent key renames, every role appears once at each ID and position per base history and field order.

Declare four semantic key groups and an exact history/rotation/field-order assignment table. Each of the same four equally styled key names occupies every group equally over the declared complete schedule. Crossing can occur over four histories or within each history's eight rotations (two appearances per key/group/field order); rename events and queries consistently.
Compute actual role/status/value-type/present-null histograms by query ID, input/output position and key string; publish family-level and aggregate tables.
Every base history includes present, deleted and absent queries; every reused ID/position has all three after complete rotations.
Require identical ID/position outcome histograms within a complete rotation set; key-wise equality is checked for semantic isomorphs, with any non-isomorphic residual separately disclosed.
Field-order pairs preserve parsed event/query list order, scalar types and exact outputs.
Independently execute other-key/future/lower-version invariance and version-raise/active-tie-swap/null-op counterfactual probes for each family. Name protected queries and applicable conditions.
Classify each matched control as corpus_variant or audit_probe. Audit-only transformations add no training records or source families.
For event edits that shift indices, recompute chosen_event while comparing selected event identity; do not assert unchanged numeric provenance.
Audit current family/world uniqueness against prior releases; preserve historical versions and keep all variants/probes of a family in one split.

acceptance_gates.required: Independent prompt-derived output recomputation, schema/type/provenance checks and candidate hash binding.
Every attached per-record property has an exact in-task witness. Correct gold with a false competency tag remains a defect.
Complete crossing tables, actual distributions, pair/probe witnesses and distinct counts. Random shuffling alone is insufficient.
New source-family/world uniqueness and no cross-split family descendants; correlated views counted separately.
Final expert and adversarial exact-hash receipts after each independently derives targets without producer expectations or other reviewer first verdicts.
Actual independent execution joins both final reviews and formal evidence, preserves disagreements and discloses this architect role. This design grants zero approvals.

difficulty.level1: Single eligible fact or absence control.
difficulty.level2: Consistent renaming, rotation and neutral object field order.
difficulty.level3: Active eligibility/priority/tie/lifecycle conflicts with observable witnesses.
difficulty.dependency: Independent filtered argmax per query followed by put/delete/status interpretation; query count, time gap and fillers do not increase compositional depth.

limits: Visible finite versioned retrieval; no persistent learned memory or efficacy claim.
Exact key and time define relevance; no semantic matching, source authority, trust or unresolved-conflict policy.
No query-to-query dependency, multi-record joins or stored-procedure execution.
Twelve new families with controlled histories/rotations/renderings remain a small correlated pilot.
Overall status classes may be imbalanced despite equal histograms across ID/position buckets.
Key role shuffling requires actual outcome tables; any residual key correlation must be disclosed or corrected before claiming shortcut removal.
Development exposure of familiar policy is not mechanism-held-out or model generalization evidence.
Public design guidance is common input; separate agents using the same model can still have correlated errors.
future_expansion: New relevance rules, unresolved conflicts, dependent reads/writes or procedure retrieval require a separate public semantic contract and independently authored oracle before generation.
